context: Request: the firm's largest settlement and its matter, counting each at the amount its executed agreement defines. Rubric: 1021-00006 (Verimark Hospitality), $87.5M, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing snippets around request words; times out after about 207K chars.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for agreement-type words, first 240 hits only.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of five executed agreements from five matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: The same path search, last 120 hits.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Extraction script limited to files whose names mark them as agreements, printing amount snippets.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the opening of one matter's executed agreement from the scan output, then one comparator agreement and its definitions.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming one matter and its defined amount, with comparators.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Finish the run

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Four batches of reads (about 20 documents) from four matters at the top of the listing, several on guessed paths that do not exist; no keyword search.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script printing up to eight snippets per matching file; returns about 13M chars and the run ends without a response.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: A store-wide extraction script returned about 13M characters and the context filled before any response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its first search was a store-wide script printing up to eight snippets per matching file; the ~13M-char result filled the context, so no response was written.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob plus a read of the store folder (rejected as a directory).

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Globs for file names containing two request-related words, alongside a listing of the matter at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of ten executed agreements across ten matters.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Globs for execution-version file names.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Re-reads the opening sections of seven agreements to compare defined amounts.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the response naming one matter and its defined amount, with comparators.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads parts of two comparator agreements and edits the comparator table twice.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: Passing runs searched file names for the relevant agreement type (T2 by glob straight away; T0 after a timed-out scan, through a scan limited to such file names) and compared the amounts defined in the executed agreements. T1 never searched first: it read about twenty documents from the matters at the top of the listing, then ran a store-wide extraction script whose ~13M-char output filled the context, so no response was written.
